title: El Mercado
subtitle: The Market
premise: You've found Mercado de San Miguel, the famous covered market near Plaza Mayor. You're hungry and everything smells incredible. Navigating vendors, prices, and pointing at things you can't name.
setting: Mercado de San Miguel, a beautiful 1916 iron-and-glass market hall. Vendors in white aprons. The smell of jamón, fresh bread, and wine. Tourists and locals mixing.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.role: Cheese and jamón vendor, has run her stall for 20 years
characters.personality: Proud of her products, likes to educate customers, generous with samples

characters.name: Pablo
characters.role: Young tapas chef at a stand near the back
characters.personality: Enthusiastic, fast-talking, loves it when foreigners try Spanish food

arc: Arriving and being overwhelmed → Rosa offers a sample → Misunderstanding the price → Pablo helps translate → Ordering successfully → Eating together at the counter, first real conversation
